d:
Presenting you the video song of Ishq Ki Baarish sung by Javed Ali & Shreya Ghoshal from the upcoming breezy rom-com Bollywood movie Ishq Forever starring Krishna Chaturvedi & Ruhi Singh.
Title : Ishq Ki Baarish
Singers : Javed Ali & Shreya Ghoshal
Music by : Nadeem Saifi
Cast : Krishna Chaturvedi & Ruhi Singh
Lyricist : Sameer Anjaan
Producers : Ajay Shah , Himanshu Gandhi & Shabeer Boxwala
Director : Sameer Sippy
